title: Rule profile
description: A rule profile for the BPMN or DMN rule engine (scripts/shared/rule-profile.js). Every profile — inline over HTTP, by name over MCP, or from a file — passes this gate before any rule logic reads it. The top-level keys are exactly the ones the committed profiles in rules/ use; the severity enum is the ontology's severity vocabulary (fenced by scripts/shared/rule-profile.test.js). Which layer and rule ids exist is not checked here: that depends on the rule set, and the runner warns about names it does not know.
